entries.source: You have met what seems to be a future version of yourself.
entries.target: 你遇到了一个似乎是未来的自己的人。

entries.source: You were killed by your future self, and thus this event never occured.
entries.target: 你被未来的自己杀掉了，因此这件事从未发生过。

entries.source: Meet the guardian!
entries.target: 去见守护者！

entries.source: This rift in time has been created by the paradox. You dare not enter it; it could make things worse. Another Warden will have to fix your mess.
entries.target: 这道时间裂隙是悖论造成的。你不敢进入，那可能会让事情变得更糟。只能让另一位时空守卫来收拾这个烂摊子了。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have unlocked the hall of reflections.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你解锁了反射之间。#WHITE#

entries.source: The fortress's current energy level is: #LIGHT_GREEN#%d#WHITE#.
entries.target: 堡垒当前能量：#LIGHT_GREEN#%d#WHITE#。

entries.source: A mysterious staff
entries.target: 奇怪的法杖

entries.source: Deep in the Dreadfell you fought and destroyed the Master, a powerful vampire.
entries.target: 在恐惧王座深处你与领主——一个强大的吸血鬼——战斗并消灭了他。

entries.source: On your way out of the Dreadfell you were ambushed by a band of orcs.
entries.target: 当你走出恐惧王座时，你遭到一队兽人伏击。

entries.source: They asked about the staff.
entries.target: 他们问起了法杖的事。

entries.source: On your way out of the Dreadfell you were ambushed by a band of orcs and left for dead.
entries.target: 当你走出恐惧王座时，你遭到一队兽人伏击，并被他们丢下等死。

entries.source: They asked about the staff and stole it from you.
entries.target: 他们问起了法杖的事，并把它从你手中抢走了。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#Go at once to Last Hope to report those events!
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#立刻到最后的希望汇报所发生的情况！

entries.source: You told them nothing and vanquished them.
entries.target: 你什么也没告诉他们，并把他们全都消灭了。

entries.source: In its remains, you found a strange staff. It radiates power and danger and you dare not use it yourself.
entries.target: 在他的尸体上，你发现了一根奇怪的法杖，它辐射出的力量和危险使你不敢使用它。

entries.source: You should bring it to the elders of Last Hope in the southeast.
entries.target: 你应该把它带给位于东南方的最后的希望长老们。

entries.source: #00FFFF#You can feel the power of this staff just by carrying it. This is both ancient and dangerous.
entries.target: #00FFFF#你拿着法杖就可以感受到它的力量。它既古老又危险。

entries.source: #00FFFF#It should be shown to the wise elders in Last Hope!
entries.target: #00FFFF#应该把它交给最后的希望的智慧长老看看！

entries.source: #VIOLET#As you come out of the Dreadfell, you encounter a band of orcs!
entries.target: #VIOLET#当你走出恐惧王座，你遭遇了一队兽人！

entries.source: Ambush
entries.target: 伏击

entries.source:
You wake up after a few hours, surprised to be alive, but the staff is gone!
#VIOLET#Go at once to Last Hope to report those events!
entries.target:
几个小时以后，你醒了过来，惊讶地发现自己还活着，不过法杖已经不见了！
#VIOLET#立刻返回最后的希望报告这件事！

entries.source: Ukruk the Fierce
entries.target: 凶残的乌克鲁克

entries.source:
You are surprised to still be alive.
#VIOLET#Go at once to Last Hope to report those events!
entries.target:
令人惊讶，你竟然活了下来！
#VIOLET#立刻返回最后的希望报告这件事！

entries.source: Of trolls and damp caves
entries.target: 巨魔与潮湿洞窟

entries.source: Explore the caves below the ruins of Kor'Pul and the Trollmire in search of treasure and glory!
entries.target: 到卡·普尔废墟和巨魔沼泽的地下城去发现宝藏和荣耀！

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Trollmire and vanquished Shax the Troll.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了巨魔沼泽并击败了巨魔夏克斯。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Trollmire and vanquished Prox the Troll.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了巨魔沼泽并击败了巨魔普罗克斯。#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* You must explore the Trollmire and find out what lurks there and what treasures are to be gained!#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 你必须进入巨魔沼泽去调查那里潜伏着什么怪物并找到那里的宝藏！#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the ruins of Kor'Pul and vanquished the Possessed.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你探索了卡·普尔废墟并击败了恶灵附身的强盗头目。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the ruins of Kor'Pul and vanquished the Shade.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你探索了卡·普尔废墟并击败了暗影骷髅。#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* You must explore the ruins of Kor'Pul and find out what lurks there and what treasures are to be gained!#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 你必须进入卡·普尔废墟去调查那里潜伏着什么怪物并找到那里的宝藏！#WHITE#

entries.source: Spellblaze Fallouts
entries.target: 魔法大爆炸的余波

entries.source: The Abashed Expanse is a part of Eyal torn apart by the Spellblaze and thrown into the void between the stars.
entries.target: 次元浮岛曾是埃亚尔的一部分，在魔法大爆炸中被撕裂并抛入星辰之间的虚空。

entries.source: It has recently begun to destabilize, threatening to crash onto Eyal, destroying everything in its path.
entries.target: 它最近开始变得不稳定，有与埃亚尔发生碰撞的危险，这将会摧毁一切它所碰到的东西。

entries.source: You have entered it and must now stabilize three wormholes by firing any spell at them.
entries.target: 你已经进入了那里，现在必须对三个虫洞施法以稳定它们。

entries.source: Remember, the floating islands are not stable and might teleport randomly. However, the disturbances also help you: your Phase Door spell is fully controllable even if not of high level yet.
entries.target: 记住，浮岛上很不稳定，有可能将你随机传送，不过也有一个好处，你可以完全控制你的相位门技能，就算你的技能等级不够高也没关系。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the expanse and closed all three wormholes.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了整个浮岛并关闭了所有三个虫洞。#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* You have closed %s wormhole(s).#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 你关闭了 %s 个虫洞。#WHITE#

entries.source: Reknor is lost!
entries.target: 瑞库纳沦陷了！

entries.source: You were part of a group of dwarves sent to investigate the situation of the kingdom of Reknor.
entries.target: 你是一支矮人小分队的一员，这支小分队被派往瑞库纳王国调查情况。

entries.source: When you arrived there you found nothing but orcs, well organized and very powerful.
entries.target: 当你到达那里时，你只发现了组织严密且非常强大的兽人。

entries.source: Most of your team was killed there and now you and Norgan (the sole survivor besides you) must hurry back to the Iron Council to bring the news.
entries.target: 你队伍中大多数人被杀死，现在你和诺尔甘（除你以外的唯一幸存者）必须赶紧回到钢铁议会去汇报这里的情况。

entries.source: Let nothing stop you.
entries.target: 别让任何东西阻挡你。

entries.source: Both Norgan and you made it home.
entries.target: 你和诺尔甘都回到了家。

entries.source: Norgan
entries.target: 诺尔甘

entries.source: Future Echoes
entries.target: 未来的回音

entries.source: The unhallowed morass is the name of the 'zone' surrounding Point Zero.
entries.target: 混沌之沼是零点圣域周围区域的名字。

entries.source: The temporal spiders that inhabit it are growing restless and started attacking at random. You need to investigate what is going on.
entries.target: 栖息在那里的时空蜘蛛日益焦躁，开始随机发起攻击。你得去调查一下到底发生了什么事。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the morass and destroyed the weaver queen, finding strange traces on it.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你探索了混沌之沼并杀死了织网蛛后，发现了奇怪的痕迹。#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* You must explore the morass.#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 你必须探索混沌之沼。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have helped defend Point Zero.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你成功守卫了零点圣域。#WHITE#

entries.source: Echoes of the Spellblaze
entries.target: 魔法大爆炸的回音

entries.source: You have heard that within the scintillating caves lie strange crystals imbued with Spellblaze energies.
entries.target: 你听说在闪光洞穴中有一些被魔法大爆炸能量影响的奇怪水晶。

entries.source: There are also rumours of a renegade Shaloren camp to the west.
entries.target: 有传闻说西面有堕落的永恒精灵的营地。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the scintillating caves and destroyed the Spellblaze Crystal.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了闪光洞穴，并摧毁了魔法大爆炸水晶。#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* You must explore the scintillating caves.#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 你必须探索闪光洞穴。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Rhaloren camp and killed the Inquisitor.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了罗兰精灵营地并杀死了检察官。#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* You must explore the renegade Shaloren camp.#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 你必须探索那些堕落的永恒精灵的营地。#WHITE#

entries.source: Serpentine Invaders
entries.target: 蛇形的侵略者

entries.source:
Nagas are invading the slazish fens. The Sunwall cannot fight on two fronts; you need to stop the invaders before it is too late.
 Locate and destroy the invaders' portal.
entries.target:
娜迦正在攻击斯拉伊什沼泽，太阳堡垒不能同时两线作战，你必须抓紧时间阻止那些侵略者，以免为时过晚。
 找到并摧毁侵略者的传送门。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have destroyed the naga portal. The invasion is stopped.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你摧毁了娜迦的传送门，侵略者被阻止了。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You are back in Var'Eyal, the Far East as the people from the west call it.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你回到了瓦·埃亚尔——西方人把这里称作远东。#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* However, you were teleported to a distant land. You must find a way back to the Gates of Morning.#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 然而，你被传送到了一个遥远的区域，你必须找到返回晨曦之门的方法。#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* You must stop the nagas.#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 你必须阻止那些娜迦。#WHITE#

entries.source: Madness of the Ages
entries.target: 疯狂的岁月

entries.source: The Thaloren forest is disrupted. Corruption is spreading. Norgos the guardian bear is said to have gone mad.
entries.target: 自然精灵森林陷入了混乱，到处肆虐着堕落。据说守护巨熊诺尔格斯已经陷入了疯狂。

entries.source: On the western border of the forest a gloomy aura has been set up. Things inside are... twisted.
entries.target: 有人在森林的西部边境布下了一个黑暗光环，里面的东西已陷入了扭曲。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored Norgos' Lair and stopped the shivgoroth invasion.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了诺尔格斯的巢穴并阻止了寒冰元素的侵略。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored Norgos' Lair and put it to rest.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了诺尔格斯的巢穴并埋葬了它。#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* You must explore Norgos' Lair.#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 你必须调查诺尔格斯的巢穴。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Heart of the Gloom and slain the Dreaming One.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了黑暗之心并杀死了梦境者。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Heart of the Gloom and slain the Withering Thing.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了黑暗之心并杀死了凋零之物。#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* You must explore the Heart of the Gloom.#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 你必须探索黑暗之心。#WHITE#

entries.source: The rotting stench of the dead
entries.target: 死者腐烂的恶臭

entries.source: You have been resurrected as an undead by some dark powers.
entries.target: 你被某种黑暗力量复活为不死生物。

entries.source: However, the ritual failed in some way and you retain your own mind. You need to get out of this dark place and try to carve a place for yourself in the world.
entries.target: 不过，复活仪式似乎出了点问题，你保留了自己的意识。你必须离开这个黑暗的地方，设法在这个世界上为自己谋得一席之地。

entries.source: You have found a very special cloak that will help you walk among the living without trouble.
entries.target: 你发现了一个非常神奇的斗篷，可以使你在活人之中自由生活而不会陷入麻烦。
